## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List checks actually run and any limits. State whether hardware was contacted;
identify authorization for every live write, power operation or input action.
Do not include credentials, private addresses, tickets or raw device responses.

## AI disclosure

For AI-assisted work, replace every placeholder with the actual value and include
this block in each relevant commit. Ask the author for unknown model/settings.
Use one block per agent/model. For human-only work, replace this section with
"No AI assistance used."

```text
AI-Agent: {agent name}
AI-Model-Version: {model name and complexity, request from author if necessary}
AI-Inference-Date: {timestamp}
```
